text:
lee-sales: Need a hosted demo key for Fjord Health POC next Tue. Requirements: single laptop key (chat+embeds), IP allowlist for 3 site IPs, short TTL, webhook notify when rotated, and a one-page kill/rotate playbook for their security reviewer. Also want billing_code 'poc/fjord' so finance can attribute.

tara-eng: We can provision ephemeral hosted keys and wire a webhook for rotation events. Recommend 24h TTL unless they sign off on 48h. We'll create primary + standby and put both into 1Password. Send IPs + demo contact.

lee-sales: IPs: 198.51.100.70, 198.51.100.71, 198.51.100.72. Contact: demo@fjord.example.com. They asked if there is a one-click revoke in the Console.

tara-eng: Yes — Console has a one-click "Kill Key" button that calls the revoke API under the hood. Also we can emit a webhook on revoke/create/rotate. Example create API I will run (admin token redacted):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \\ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \\ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\ 
  -d '{"name":"poc-fjord-demo","scopes":["chat","embeddings"],"expires_in":86400,"rate_limit":10,"allowlist_ips":["198.51.100.70","198.51.100.71","198.51.100.72"],"metadata":{"billing_code":"poc/fjord","contact":"demo@fjord.example.com"}}'

rotator-bot: key created: hosted_fjord_demo_2165000000  created_by: tara-eng  expires_in: 24h  scopes: chat, embeddings  rate_limit:10 req/s

mike-sec: For the security questionnaire include: Console Activity CSV (create/rotate/revoke), webhook delivery logs, and screenshot of the key metadata. Note: hosted keys are managed in Redwood control plane; per-customer KMS wrapping is only on Private/Dedicated enterprise plan. Mark as blocker if they require KMS/HSM.

lee-sales: Customer also wants the playbook to show an emergency flow if laptop is lost mid-demo.

tara-eng: Playbook bullets I'll include: 1) Hit Console "Kill Key" or call revoke endpoint, 2) Issue standby key (pre-stored in 1Password) and swap into demo laptop, 3) Export Activity CSV & webhook logs and share with customer security contact, 4) If they require KMS escalate to Solutions Eng for Private trial. Revoke example:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/hosted_fjord_demo_2165000000/revoke \\ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'

mike-sec: Also note we do not expose plaintext over email. For the webhook rotation pattern we send a retrieval URL that requires a short-lived signed token; the webhook never contains plaintext. That should satisfy mid-market auditors.

rotator-bot: key revoked: hosted_fjord_demo_2165000000  revoked_by: tara-eng  revocation_time: 2165000123

lee-sales: Thanks team  uploaded the playbook, Console CSV, and revoke screenshot to the deal folder and shared with the customer security reviewer. They accepted 24h + allowlist. Closing loop. :thumbsup:
